reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 7 points better, in a game of about 226 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Hawks.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Hawks.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 65 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 200 and 249 total points.
